# swo_circleciintegration (Resource)

A terraform resource for managing CircleCI integrations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the CircleCI integration.

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) The CircleCI API token. Used to fetch project metadata and logs.
- `receiver_base` (String) The receiver URL base. Defaults to the SWO production endpoint. Default is `https://webhook.swo.solarwinds.com/webhook`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The Id of the resource provided by the backend.
- `receiver_url` (String) The receiver URL to configure in CircleCI project webhook.
- `secret_token` (String, Sensitive) The secret token to configure in CircleCI project webhook and used to authenticate incoming webhooks.
